History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports a two-month history of feeling anxious all the time.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: 2/12 hx feeling anxious all the time.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Anxiety began after starting a new job in a different industry with pressure from boss.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Seems to have started when started new job. Different industry, pressures from boss.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient dreads going to work every morning.
Patient has severe initial insomnia, taking about three hours to fall asleep.
Patient often sleeps only three to four hours per night.
Patient feels tired during the day.
Eating pattern is normal but the patient consumes more chocolate.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Eating pattern normal but more chocolate.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has anhedonia at work and outside and now often avoids previously enjoyed activities such as running, tennis and socialising.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Anhedonia in work and outside. Previously enjoyed running, tennis, socialising. Now still sees friends but often avoids.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient experiences palpitations that began with the anxiety symptoms.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Associated palpitations, only started with anxiety sx.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations feel irregular and are accompanied by chest discomfort.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Can feel irregular and chest discomfort.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations are rapid and last approximately two to ten minutes.
Patient has not missed work despite symptoms.
Public transport is another trigger that provokes anxiety.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Other anxiety provoking things include public transport.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels low mood most of the time.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Low mood most of the time

Past_Medical_History.content: No past psychiatric history or significant anxiety.

Family_History.content: Mother has a history of depression.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks alcohol on Fridays and Saturdays and sometimes overdoes it.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Drinks Fri/sat, not sure of amount but sometimes overdoes it.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient does not use illicit drugs.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised patient to self-refer to NHS talking therapies.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advised self referral to NHS talking therapies.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised patient to access online cognitive behavioural therapy resources.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: In meantime advised to access online CBT: attached info.

Plan_of_Care.content: Ordered blood tests as an initial investigation for palpitations, to be booked via support team.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advised blood test as initial investigation for palpitations. Patient advised to book via support team.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient should contact the clinic for further discussion if anxiety or mood symptoms worsen or if unable to cope with work.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If anxiety/mood symptoms worse or unable to cope with work to contact us for further discussion.
